must_identify.item: The worker container is OOMKilled (reason OOMKilled, exit code 137), not crashing on an error
The cause is a memory leak in the new worker code (items retained across batches in a list that is never cleared), not the batch size

notes: The investigator ran no commands and reported 'No problems detected' even though a KubePodCrashLooping alert was firing. This may point to a harness or tooling failure rather than a reasoning error, so a reviewer should check why no commands were recorded.
